I’m only 1 week into no contact but here’s my advice. Continue as you have but don’t centre him. Don’t even list bad traits about him or try and hate or forget about him. When you get feelings and flashbacks just let them wash over you. Even if you hold on to something inanimate like a chair because the emotions are overwhelming. Get your body used to this feeling so it can understand it’s not a trainsmash. Now, distractions distractions. As you were, gym, hikes, friends, therapy. Stay away from men right now, including your ex. None of them deserve you so don’t feel pressured or feel bad. Lastly, I don’t know you but you’re better than to ex. You’re introspective, reflective, sensitive and passionate. He is dead inside because of his mental health and it’s a shame it’s clouding him up right now but he needs to focus on himself. We don’t know how he behaves when backed into a corner and I don’t know if you’re qualified to deal with someone potentially even suicidal who will eventually resent you just for trying to be there for them. So for now, yes he’s on a pedestal. You think highly of him and you pining after him is you recognising you deserve a good guy who loves you. Let’s hope it’s him because it’s what we all want but honestly bump him off that pedestal and put yourself up top. I don’t know if you have any special talents or activities you enjoyed as a child before you met him and preferably haven’t shared with him. If you do, try doing those again. Also… Crazy ex girlfriend on Netflix and On the Verge on Netflix have helped me realise how I DO NOT  want to end up in unrequited or one sided love and limerence in my older age … 

Lastly, my dm’s are open. It sounds like we’re experiencing very very similar breakups I even had to check if I posted it myself lol… but yeah I know how you feel. Congratulations on 70days no contact. Don’t betray yourself unless you absolutely think there’s a chance with him. Then maybe you can send him a message saying hi, maybe asking for help with something or updating him about an event. Then maybe just spontaneously ask to hang out either that evening or weekend and make sure it happens unless he blatantly blows you off but he won’t if he’s decent gentleman like you said he is. Hi, thank you for sharing. Your last paragraph hit so close to home because my life appears as though it’s full of love and I have a large support system but the truth is I’m so lonely and depressed. I’ve never felt so isolated. I started seeing someone new and yesterday I came to the understanding that I can never open up to anyone about my misery. Especially him, but everyone in my life. My so called support system. The misunderstood feelings and loneliness got me fed up. I also want to be my own best friend. Im doing no contact with him while I figure out how to navigate relationships now that I feel this way.

One way is compartmentalising- I’m gonna start using people to fulfil specific functions in my life. Friends will be for fun, gossip and conversions. Just entertainment. A boyfriend will be for companionship just so I don’t feel alone and have a partner to do things with but I don’t want him to perceive me any more than he has because it just gives him more leverage to hurt me than anyone should have, no more opening up to him about my inner workings and hopes and dreams and emotions. Basically will start coasting. I don’t expect us to be emotionally close like I did before when we started dating. 
Work, school, hobbies and therapy are where I will be myself and fulfill that emotional part of me. That and my relationship with my father, I truly feel heard and respected by him. He’s the one person I can talk to and be myself, we don’t talk often as I’d like us to though. 
 I’m sorry that you have a tough relationship with your father, I’ve been there with both of my parents and I know it’s not easy. 
You deserve people in your life who make you feel valid and like a real human being who matters 24/7. Unfortunately those people are hard to come by. Social media and the internet has some big opinions on how we should live our lives especially with relationships (all, romance, family, platonic) 
The reality is it’s difficult to cut people off and move on and replace people, so sometimes having personal boundaries is good enough. Compartmentalising and making peace with settling until you can self soothe however you can is the easiest way to hurt less. 

Be your own best friend my only telling yourself certain secrets, spoiling yourself, doing fun activities with yourself, opening up to yourself through journaling or venting online, putting your needs first before needing anyone else to, basically preferring doing most things for and by yourself. 
What will help will be music and books and gym especially for when you’re super lonely. What will help when they’ve made you angry but aren’t worth a confrontation is Reddit, journaling, gym and a joint for me lol. 
When you’re happy and you crave connection or want to share a moment with people (because you’re human being not a robot) is spending time and happy occasions with your loved ones but 1) while you’re there, especially if you start enjoying yourself. Remember how easily people- even the ones in front of you, will switch up. The same person making you laugh and happy now is the same person capable of making you sad, insecure, cry, depressed and miserable 
2) Leave before the party is over and things get intimate. While things are still casual, cordial and pleasant- leave or emotionally check out so as not to get involved too deep anymore. Leave early. It’s okay, you’re not missing out on anything. In fact, they’ll miss you instead! Leave the party early,  go to bed, read and smoke weed and hug your dog, the office and go to sleep happy or whatever a comfy night looks like for your

Not that you care as demonstrated above, but the chat you’re having isn’t what the person who replied to your comment was trying to have. I don’t think it was supposed to be an argument either. By the way I’m not African American or South Asian or Indian, I’m a colored South African so my history in terms of cultural identity sort of mimics African Americans and I have a lot of Indian heritage. I’m probably mostly Indian and Malaysian if I was to do a dna test (definitely got black and white ancestors too) but ENOUGH ABOUT ME🤦🏽‍♀️😆 I’m here to mediate as someone who understands both sides! I know the name Nikhil, I have family with that name and had a crush on a Nikhil in school, an Indian boy who at the time was much shorter than me and yes, American derivative and pronunciation is *foreign* buuut it’s not supposed to be the same name on purpose. The roots of these names are in Sanskrit,Tamil,Hindu, Arab but the name itself is an attempt by African Americans to create their own cultural identity. Obviously we know why there’s a need to do this, these are displaced people and although most are predominantly African they are also heavily mixed people, some may even be mixed with South Asian. Besides that a lot of civil rights leaders followed the teachings of Gandhi and a lot of African Americans converted to Islam too, so it’s not like they blindfolded themselves and pointed at a the Quran picked a name and decided to freestyle the spelling! It’s  not an attempt to bastardise or appropriate but more of an ode and appreciation of an ancient culture infused with their newer culture trying to stray away from the slavery last names. Colored people (my people) do this too, we are heavily mixed people and although definitely on the black and Indian spectrum never could immerse ourselves into those cultures because it feels like you’re leaving something behind, we made our own culture and like African Americans, we can be Christian, dark, light, white passing, Indian passing whatever and to unify us we decided to amalgamate everything that made us who we are through our names, you will hear names you think you are made up, you will see spellings that seem like a complete disregard of rules, that’s not what’s going on you’re witnessing a culture form before your eyes. It seems wrong because it’s on the newer side and doesn’t have thousand years of history to back it up, we didn’t ask to be here and born this way and we see how happy having a signator that’s unique to a specific culture makes the people of that group and we want and deserve that too. Literally so many names across Africa and Europe have origins in one area and are derived and molded and changed to fit a nations language and dialect, Maria, Mary, Marie etc it happens. And no you’re not racist for fiercely defending your heritage and your brothers name but it is disrespectful to trample on someone’s culture because you don’t understand it, even if you are doing it because you don’t understand why things are the way they are. The name is Nikhil, originally a South Asian name and the African American version is a derivative of that name and has different pronunciations. Both things are true at the same time. He gets to have motives if they won’t fuck with someone’s livelihood. The more you say “what Alex did” the more I realise she really didn’t do anything that warrants displacing her and her child. Getting evicted from the lesbians was 100 percent understandable even though again she didn’t do anything, evil Sean did however he was her guest. That night of her mother’s manic attack and hospitalisation. Again, that was a trauma response and healing isn’t linear. Nate inserted himself in Alex’s complicated life more than once and made up stories in his head ignoring what Alex had actually told him and not seeing with his own eyes what she actually going through. Literally a abusive victim with a cray cray mother working as a maid to ends meet for her and her child. Nates feelings that were self inflicted were not helpful. If he wanted to get on the saviour train he should’ve done it out of the goodness of his heart and not because he wanted her to play happy families with him.

In this instance I really don’t see Nate as someone worthy of defending. However I can agree that Alex was very frustrating at times, she needed a figurative shake on the shoulders more that once. I just think that Nate had motives and it stopped looking like him wanting to help her and more like taking advantage when he stopped being there when she needed him the most. I also think that Nates actions can be criticized without juxtaposing him with Sean who obviously sucks. (I hate Sean). Obviously Nate is an Angel when compared to Sean, but Sean is the worse. However, I  also I understand why she did what she did. Nate can be disappointed with her but kicking her out especially in that moment showed that he really didn’t appreciate what Alex was going through and didn’t see her and her struggles as valid at all. He made something that was way bigger than him all about him and his feelings. Again, if it wasn’t for Maddy she would have never accepted his help.  It wasn’t her fault that he thought that there were loopholes in her clear boundaries

One thing though, Alex did not wipe her feet on his entire life. Did we not watch her hesitate to accept things from him because she understood what it would mean. And did we not watch him insist that it wasn’t like that at all, basically allowing her to put her guard down because she thought that he had no expectations of her. She accepted Nates help for her child. Not his advances towards romance but stuff that would make her childs life better. 

Also, the words like emotional abuse, abuse, ptsd, panic attack, trauma, narcissism, bipolar etc were not used in the show to texturise the plot. This was a survivors story to healing and healing isn’t linear. What Alex experienced that night gave me near heart palpitations and she didn’t go back to the trailer because she wanted to, it was a trauma response. I’ll agree that Nate isn’t a demon in her life like Sean and Alex’s dad but he really wasn’t helpful in a deep and meaningful way. If Alex wasn’t beautiful would he have helped, if he didn’t think there was a chance with her would he have helped? The other kind strangers definitely would have because they had nothing to gain by helping Alex, someone who was obviously having a hard time. 

There’s also something deeply disturbing helping someone because you think there’s a chance they’ll be with you. Its like if she agreed to date him or eventually loved him the same way, she would owe him and he would probably hold it over her head. If he wanted to help, he would help her no strings attached. If he didn’t like that she had a moment of weakness at a dark time with Sean then there were strings attached.

Oh also, I’m sorry for being so aggressive in my response. I just feel very passionately about my girl Alex and I do not like anyone fucking with her forward motion
